text: At 16', Seabrook Town’s momentum shift is underpinned by their 3-4-3 system enabling an overload on the flanks, leading to 9 final third entries and 2 corners within an 8-minute window, aligning with their wide, crossing play strategy against Harbour City’s deeper 4-2-3-1 patient short passing setup. Their possession of 63.3% and pass accuracy of 84.9% indicate effective ball retention, supported by a pressing trigger demonstrated by a lower PPDA of 4.2 compared to Harbour's 6.5, facilitating quicker turnovers and transitions into wide attacks. The resultant two shots with combined xG 0.11, including an Adeyemi shot saved and a Marlowe header off target, illustrate the successful execution of sustained wide overloads and pressure creating crossing opportunities against Harbour City’s rest-defence and patient buildup.
